notes: U5 is a compact event CONTROLLER (console) for P20/P10/Q8/P80, not a video switcher; no category for consoles so 'misc'. Dimensions include handles/rack ears. Datasheet lists connector types (Ethernet, USB type B, LTC in/out, MTC in/out, MIDI, KVM, keyboard/mouse, external input, AC 100-240 V 6 A) but NO counts, so ports left empty. U5 Pro: 1129.6 x 695.4 x 422.7 mm, 46 kg, 330 W max.
